raw.body:
I found three documentation inconsistencies.

#### 1. `react-server` README examples are missing newer `createRequest` / `createPrerenderRequest` arguments

The README examples call `createRequest` and `createPrerenderRequest` with arguments ending at `filterStackFrame`:

https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/c0cd4d5d30f3ad56380c14ac53c6f50d96e38814/packages/react-server/README.md#L41-L49
https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/c0cd4d5d30f3ad56380c14ac53c6f50d96e38814/packages/react-server/README.md#L209-L219

But the actual signatures now also include `debugStartTime` and `keepDebugAlive`:

https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/c0cd4d5d30f3ad56380c14ac53c6f50d96e38814/packages/react-server/src/ReactFlightServer.js#L782-L791
https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/c0cd4d5d30f3ad56380c14ac53c6f50d96e38814/packages/react-server/src/ReactFlightServer.js#L814-L825

Introduced by:
- `bbc13fa17be8eebef3e6ee47f48c76c0c44e2f36` — added `keepDebugAlive`
- `b1533b034ee5e38e825fe20d789f2e83ede163ad` — added `debugStartTime` / `options.startTime`

#### 2. `eslint-plugin-react-compiler` README still documents npm installation

The README still tells users to install `eslint-plugin-react-compiler` from npm:

https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/c0cd4d5d30f3ad56380c14ac53c6f50d96e38814/compiler/packages/eslint-plugin-react-compiler/README.md#L13-L17

But the package is no longer listed as publishable:

https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/c0cd4d5d30f3ad56380c14ac53c6f50d96e38814/compiler/scripts/release/shared/packages.js#L8-L12

Introduced by:
- `f508edc83fa1eb316a974c274b4411f081d6e94d`

#### 3. `eslint-plugin-react-compiler` README references removed single rule name

The README still shows the old single-rule configuration:

https://github.com/facebook/react/blob/c0cd4d5d30f3ad56380c14ac53c6f50d96e38814/compiler/packages/eslint-plugin-react-compiler/README.md#L51-L55

Introduced by:
- `7d29ecbeb24327fdcd889fe184311bbeb0f04c30`

### Candidate fixes

I have two small commits prepared:

- https://github.com/doehyunbaek/react/commit/92fde71037 — `docs: update react-server README`
- https://github.com/doehyunbaek/react/commit/a0d39e446b — `docs: update eslint-plugin-react-compiler README`

Happy to open PR(s) for these if useful.
raw.title: Doc: Update stale README docs
